Can I run a spatial error model (SEM) or spatial durbin (SDM) with the results( fitted values) of smoothed standardized incidence rates (SIRs) calculated using spatio-temporal BYM model (I mean, use as dependent these smoothed SIRs)

you mean using fitted values from one model as an offset in another?

if so, then

y ~ ... + offset(fitted.values) + ...
